description: Check a generate_sound or vary_sound job by id. Most calls finish inside those tools; use this only when one came back with status "queued" or "running" (a busy GPU or a cold start), then call again every poll_after_seconds until it is "succeeded" (takes ready, each with a curl command) or "failed" (error says why). A job that hasn't finished after 5 minutes is reported failed and doesn't count toward the limits.

id.description: The job's id, from generate_sound or vary_sound.
